text: {"assertions":["On 2026-02-14, a bug causing empty result sets in search/query/rewriter.ts was fixed.","The bug occurred for deeply nested search inputs beyond six levels containing two-word phrases with stop words.","The root cause was an unbounded retry loop in the query rewriter that lacked backoff logic.","The symptom of the bug was a rewritten query with no clauses left.","The fix capped retry attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter.","The fix was submitted as PR #1091 on branch fix/empty-result-set-1.","The error rate decreased from 8.8% to under 0.06% (6 per 10,000) after the fix.","The bug was in the same code area as previous empty result set issues that had been addressed."]}
